QuestInfo.name: Demonic Blues
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Master Loong at #m252020000#. Help him and you should get back to Noi and Somchai at the Golden Temple.
QuestInfo.1: Master Loong told you about a highly trained monk named #b#p9000080##k giving his all to stop Ravana inside the Golden Temple. The path to help him is littered with goblins. Help Master Loong and eliminate #b#o8144004##k monsters.\n#o8144004# can be found in #r#m252020100# and #m252020200##k, on the western side of the Abandoned Temple.
QuestInfo.2: Master Loong told you about a highly trained monk named #b#p9000080##k giving his all to stop Ravana inside the Golden Temple. The path to help him is littered with goblins. You helped Master Loong and eliminated #b#o8144004##k monsters.

0.0: As for you... You're quite the interesting one. I see a light within your soul. No, really. I literally see it. It's green, which means you have to save the Golden Temple.

yes.0: The demon Ravana recently awakened in this area. A lot of monks tried to fight him, but they all failed. There's only one monk left fighting now, a strong fellow named #bDao#k. He's at the Golden Altar now.
yes.1: I'm too wrinkly and feeble to do much against Ravana, so I'm keeping the Goblins at bay instead. \n\n#b#e(Suddenly, you hear a loud rumble from the western section of the underground temple.)#k
yes.2: Ah, the #b#o8144004#s#k have awakened. I can hear their spirits shrieking in rage. It's giving me a headache. Do an old man a favor and eliminate #e#b100#k#n of them. You'll find them in #r#m252020100# and #m252020200##k.

no.0: It is natural to be afraid, but you must not succumb to your fear or the light in your soul might go out!

1.0: Much better. I thought my head was going to explode from all the noise.
